cohort: Three infants with fetal tachycardia detected at 36, 40, and 38 weeks gestation.
finding: Unrecognized fetal supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) can lead to unnecessary cesarean sections for presumed fetal distress and potential prematurity-related problems.
followup_time: 3 weeks, 2 days and 8 days (time to cardioversion)
